events.title: Tupac Shakur: 30 Years
events.blurb: Marking 30 years since the tragic passing of hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Legacy of a Legend
angles.copy: Thirty years on, Tupac Shakur's influence on music and culture is still undeniable. What's your go-to track from the legend?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: 56 Years
events.blurb: Remembering Jimi Hendrix, who passed away 56 years ago today, leaving an unparalleled legacy in rock music.

angles.name: Rock God Remembered
angles.copy: On this day, we pay tribute to Jimi Hendrix, 56 years after his passing. His guitar mastery changed music forever. What's your favourite Hendrix moment?

events.title: Abbey Road turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic album 'Abbey Road' was released 57 years ago today, featuring classics like 'Come Together' and 'Here Comes the Sun'.

angles.name: Walk Across History
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That iconic cover, those timeless tracks... what's your favourite from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to Chrissie Hynde, the legendary frontwoman of The Pretenders.

angles.name: Pretenders Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! An icon of rock, her voice and attitude are unmistakable. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the legendary Liam Gallagher! From Oasis to solo success, his distinctive voice is pure rock 'n' roll. What's your top Liam tune?

events.title: 'Imagine' turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released 51 years ago today, becoming an enduring message of peace.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine' – a song that still resonates with its powerful message of peace and unity. What does it mean to you?

events.title: iPod turns 25
events.blurb: The original Apple iPod was unveiled 25 years ago today, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Music
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? Twenty-five years ago, Apple changed the game forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred) to over six decades of 007. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the best Bond theme song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the unparalleled talent of John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire. What's your favourite Lennon moment?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the iconic comedian and actor, John Cleese.

angles.name: Ministry of Silly Birthdays
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us endless laughs. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The White Album turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released 58 years ago today.

angles.name: White Album Wonders
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unveiled 'The White Album'. Its eclectic mix still sparks debate and delight. What are your standout tracks?

events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 Years
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary Freddie Mercury, who passed away 35 years ago today, leaving an indelible mark on music.

angles.name: Queen's King
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, stage presence, and legacy are truly immortal. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: Rubber Soul turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released 61 years ago today, showcasing a new direction for the band.

angles.name: Revolutionary Rubber Soul
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' shifted the musical landscape. A pivotal album that still sounds fresh. What's your top track from it?

events.title: John Lennon: 46 Years
events.blurb: Marking 46 years since the tragic passing of music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: Remembering a Visionary
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to echo globally. What's his lasting impact on you?
